summary: The victim received a fraudulent physical letter impersonating Ledger that claimed an urgent post quantum security update was required and instructed the recipient to scan a QR code. The letter contained the recipient's personal details and device information to increase credibility and direct victims to a phishing website.
user_mistake: Trusted an unsolicited physical security update request that directed users to a QR code.
prevention: Ignore QR codes from unsolicited letters / Access Ledger only through the official website
